svg.title: AI agent full-history and structured-memory context measurements
svg.desc: Two executed line charts compare 29 synthetic agent steps. Full-history request bytes rise past the 1,900-byte teaching budget, while structured checkpoint plus four recent events remains below it. The cumulative chart reports the measured reduction.
